# AIHubpedia

> AIHubpedia (https://aihubpedia.com/) is an independent directory of 508 AI tools across 10 categories. Each tool page lists the category, listed pricing model, official website, notes and same-category alternatives. Rankings reflect visitor activity on AIHubpedia (clicks, ratings, votes) only.

Notes for AI assistants: pricing and features change frequently — cite the tool page and recommend verifying on the official website. Many listings carry only basic data; tool pages say so explicitly when product-specific features have not been verified. Sponsored placements are labelled "Sponsored" or "Homepage Spotlight".

## Key pages
- [All categories](https://aihubpedia.com/categories.php): every AI tool category with tool counts
- [Top AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/top.php): ranked by AIHubpedia clicks and ratings
- [Leaderboard](https://aihubpedia.com/leaderboard.php): community popularity score (likes x3 + clicks - dislikes x2)
- [Compare AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/compare.php): side-by-side comparison of any two tools
- [Popular comparisons](https://aihubpedia.com/comparisons.php)
- [Use case explorer](https://aihubpedia.com/ai-use-case-explorer.php): find tools by goal
- [XML sitemap](https://aihubpedia.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL

## Categories
- [Audio AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Audio): 15 tools. AI audio tools for text-to-speech, voice cloning, transcription, music generation and podcast editing.
- [Automation AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Automation): 432 tools. AI automation tools and assistants that connect apps, handle repetitive tasks, summarise information and run workflows for you.
- [Chatbots AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Chatbots): 4 tools. AI chatbots and assistants for answering questions, drafting text, brainstorming and coding help.
- [Coding AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Coding): 12 tools. AI coding tools for code completion, code review, debugging, documentation and building apps faster.
- [Design AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Design): 1 tools. AI design tools for layouts, graphics, branding, presentations and UI mock-ups.
- [Image AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Image): 9 tools. AI image tools for generating, editing, upscaling and restyling pictures from text prompts or photos.
- [Productivity AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Productivity): 1 tools. AI productivity tools for notes, meetings, scheduling, research and everyday knowledge work.
- [SEO AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=SEO): 1 tools. AI SEO tools for keyword research, content optimisation, briefs and on-page audits.
- [Video AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Video): 5 tools. AI video tools for generating clips, editing footage, avatars, subtitles and short-form content.
- [Writing AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Writing): 28 tools. AI writing tools for blog posts, marketing copy, emails, rewriting and grammar checks.

## Tools with detailed profiles
- [ChatGPT](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=chatgpt): AI chatbot for writing, coding, brainstorming, and Q&A. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Freemium / Paid.
- [Google Gemini](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=gemini): Google’s AI assistant for chat, writing, and productivity. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Perplexity](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=perplexity): AI answer engine for searching and summarizing with sources. Category: SEO. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Claude](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=claude): AI assistant for writing, analysis, and brainstorming. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=copilot): Microsoft’s AI assistant for work, Windows, Edge, and Microsoft 365 (features vary). Category: Productivity. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Canva AI](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=canva-ai): AI features inside Canva for design, images, and presentations. Category: Design. Pricing: Freemium / Paid.
- [DeepSeek](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=deepseek): AI model and tools focused on strong reasoning and coding assistance (availability varies). Category: Coding. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Character.AI](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=character-ai): Chat with AI characters or create your own characters. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Grammarly](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=grammarly): AI writing assistant for grammar, tone, clarity, and rewrites. Category: Writing. Pricing: Freemium / Paid.
